title: A finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ is complete
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime number, $\mathbf Q_\ell$ the field of $\ell$-adic numbers with its absolute value $|\cdot|_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] with $E$ finite-dimensional as a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-vector space, of degree $d=[E:\mathbf Q_\ell]=\dim_{\mathbf Q_\ell}E$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Let $|\cdot|_E$ be an absolute value on $E$ whose restriction to $\mathbf Q_\ell$ (through the structure homomorphism) is $|\cdot|_\ell$ (it exists and is unique by lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value, which is not needed to state this). Then $E$ is complete for $|\cdot|_E$: every sequence $(x_n)$ in $E$ with $|x_n-x_m|_E\to0$ as $n,m\to\infty$ converges in $E$ for $|\cdot|_E$.

source.place: node def-weil-finite-field-fiber, order 411: 'For every finite extension $E/\Ql$, write $\mathcal O_E$ for its valuation ring, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and, for every $n\geq1$, set $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$' (used there without proof); the claim '$E$ is complete for $|\cdot|_E$' is made in def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension. No document in literature/ proves it; references: J.-P. Serre, Local Fields, GTM 67 (wanted in literature/LIST.md, not obtained), Ch. II, §2, Proposition 3; Bosch-Güntzer-Remmert, Non-Archimedean Analysis, Theorem 3.2.4/2 (not obtained)
